title: Tiny, cute glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left lens frame -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="52" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- Left lens fill -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="52" r="16" fill="#7BE0FF" opacity="0.55"/>
  <!-- Right lens frame -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="52" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- Right lens fill -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="52" r="16" fill="#7BE0FF" opacity="0.55"/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <path d="M52 52 Q50 44 48 52" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M16 50 Q6 44 4 36" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M84 50 Q94 44 96 36" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cute shine on left lens -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="46" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cute shine on right lens -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="46" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Tiny smiley reflection in left lens -->
  <path d="M30 56 Q34 60 38 56" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Tiny eyebrows above the glasses -->
  <path d="M26 30 Q30 26 36 30" fill="none" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 30 Q70 26 74 30" fill="none" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little heart -->
  <path d="M50 86 C46 80 38 80 38 86 C38 92 50 98 50 98 C50 98 62 92 62 86 C62 80 54 80 50 86 Z" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
</svg>
